global_preconditions.check: Read the current repository by stable numeric ID immediately before apply.
global_preconditions.failure: Block the operation on missing ID, changed identity, or stale head.

global_preconditions.check: Resolve the target slug and verify it is free or already owned by the same stable ID.
global_preconditions.failure: A different repository at the target is a hard name collision.

global_preconditions.check: Re-read default/deployment branch, rulesets, Pages settings, hosted Actions, package registries, submodules, and Git dependencies.
global_preconditions.failure: Block when protected configuration or deployment ownership changed from the recorded baseline.

global_preconditions.check: Inventory callers for workflow uses, raw assets, badges, install recipes, scripts, services, environment examples, deploy remotes, package metadata, docs anchors, OCI labels, downloads, and external integrations.
global_preconditions.failure: Do not apply until each caller is classified as presentation, runtime identity, immutable evidence, or third-party caller.

global_preconditions.check: Create an exact metadata backup and record the approved operation digest, operator, and timestamp.
global_preconditions.failure: No backup or approval means dry run only.

global_preconditions.check: Confirm active assignments and dirty checkouts are not relying on the old name during the cutover window.
global_preconditions.failure: Defer the map visualizer rename while its active implementation checkout remains in progress.

execution_order.gate: All global preconditions pass and exact authority exists.
Scoped copy changes are reviewed; runtime identifiers remain unchanged.
Fresh stable-ID/head/target/caller/backup checks and exact approval per operation.
Keep or defer current names; update display copy only through the owning source.
Stable ID, current name, redirects, Actions callers, Pages routes, deployment branch, and relevant forms/fixtures are rechecked.

manual_apply_checklist: Obtain exact recorded authorization for each repository/settings operation.
Re-read stable ID, current name, target availability, default/deployment branches, exact heads, protected configuration, open PRs, and active work.
Create and hash the metadata/site backup; record its private rollback destination.
Run the caller inventory and classify every old-name reference.
Apply one authorized operation at a time using the supported GitHub API/CLI operation actually available.
Record the requested operation, actual response, timestamp, operator authority, and observed post-state.
Verify redirects, hosted Actions, raw links, package/registry callers, Pages routes/anchors, website forms, and source/runtime identities.
Stop on any mismatch; do not infer success from a local remote change, HTTP home-page success, or a green unrelated check.
